# Rust dependency inventory

Generated from the Apple Silicon Cargo dependency trees for the included gateway and controller, using the corresponding local crate manifests. `rust-dependencies.json` records declared license expressions and copied notice filenames. Build dependencies may be included. Eighteen registry packages did not include a license or notice file in the local crate directory; their upstream notices need review. The inventory is a review aid, not a completed legal review. JavaScript/frontend and any native or system dependencies require separate review.

Packages with no matching registry source: csswitch-codex-network@0.0.0, csswitch-gateway@0.0.0, csswitch-provider-contracts@0.1.0, csswitch-skill-install-core@0.1.0, desktop@0.8.4.
